base_configuration:
# EXPLORATORY MOTOR DEMONSTRATOR SEED. See docs/MOTOR_FOUR_BAR.md.
# This is a numerically verified first-level model result, not a validated design.

[metadata]
example_data = true
description = "Motor demonstrator shared-crank four-bar seed at 25/325 deg C; uncalibrated exchanger hardware"

[working_gas]
gas_constant = 287.0
heat_capacity_cp = 1004.5
heat_capacity_cv = 717.5

[reservoirs]
cold_temperature = 298.15
hot_temperature = 598.15

[operation]
angular_speed = -12.566370614359172 # 2 Hz, motor direction

[charge]
pressure = 100000.0
temperature = 298.15

[geometry]
# Swept-volume ratio S/L = 0.84 with one-percent clearances.
small_cylinder_minimum_volume = 8.316831683168318e-06
small_cylinder_maximum_volume = 0.00084
large_cylinder_minimum_volume = 9.900990099009901e-06
large_cylinder_maximum_volume = 0.001
cold_heat_exchanger_volume = 1.9801980198019803e-05
hot_heat_exchanger_volume = 1.9801980198019803e-05

# Exchanger hold-up above is a numerical seed, not Doty bank envelope.
[heat_transfer]
# Existing constant-UA closure; NOT calibrated from Doty gas/gas measurements.
cold_ua = 49.504275427542765
hot_ua = 49.504275427542765

[hydraulics]
# Explicit numerical regularization; convergence is checked separately.
orifice_pressure_regularization = 0.03
large_to_hot_cda = 0.0001663343654365437
small_to_cold_cda = 0.0002970256525652566
hot_to_small_valve_cda = 0.0001663343654365437
cold_to_large_valve_cda = 0.0005940513051305131

[valves]
model = "continuous_ideal_diode"

[valves.hot_to_small]
opening_pressure_difference = 0.0
closing_pressure_difference = 0.0

[valves.cold_to_large]
opening_pressure_difference = 0.0
closing_pressure_difference = 0.0

[kinematics]
type = "shared_crank_rocker"
# Physical scale selected so the large-piston bore/stroke ratio is about 1.
ground_distance = 0.11937584698725914
crank_ratio = 0.37769683420658107
crank_angle_offset_degrees = 304.375
crank_direction = -1

[kinematics.small_four_bar]
coupler_ratio = 1.0535716178640724
rocker_ratio = 1.083007834497839
output_along_ratio = 0.6936068420112134
output_normal_ratio = -0.8709663633070887
assembly_branch = 1
slider_rod_ratio = 5.0

[kinematics.large_four_bar]
coupler_ratio = 1.0105247422773391
rocker_ratio = 1.0263298945873975
output_along_ratio = 0.7577473468333483
output_normal_ratio = 0.8755956188030541
assembly_branch = -1
slider_rod_ratio = 5.0

[validity]
maximum_pressure_equalization_error = 0.05
maximum_mach_number = 0.2
maximum_isothermality_error = 0.05
maximum_compressibility_deviation = 0.01
maximum_cp_variation = 0.01

[numerical]
integration_method = "LSODA"
integration_relative_tolerance = 1.0e-7
integration_absolute_tolerance = 1.0e-9
maximum_step_angle_degrees = 0.5
maximum_valve_events_per_cycle = 100
maximum_cycles = 100
periodic_relative_tolerance = 1.0e-6
periodic_mass_absolute_tolerance = 1.0e-12
periodic_energy_absolute_tolerance = 1.0e-6
hardware_configuration:
# 50% more tubes and inverse length scaling preserve tube contact area.
# Screening inputs, not selected hardware or a Doty-calibrated design.
# Tube diameter/wall/pitch originate from Doty; length and count are redesigned.
[geometry]
tube_count = 3708
tube_length_m = 0.042333333333333334
inner_diameter_m = 0.00033
wall_thickness_m = 0.0001524
pitch_m = 0.00125
header_depth_m = 0.002
additional_internal_volume_m3 = 0.000002

[properties]
# Illustrative metal properties; no alloy has been selected.
metal_conductivity_w_m_k = 15.0
metal_density_kg_m3 = 8000.0
metal_cp_j_kg_k = 500.0
extra_wall_capacity_j_k = 2.0
# Constant transport values and Nusselt numbers are sensitivity inputs.
gas_conductivity_w_m_k = 0.03
gas_viscosity_pa_s = 0.00002
gas_nusselt = 3.66
air_conductivity_w_m_k = 0.03
air_viscosity_pa_s = 0.00002
air_nusselt = 4.0
air_cp_j_kg_k = 1005.0
air_mass_flow_kg_s = 0.2194268805038944
air_poiseuille_number = 64.0
air_minor_loss_coefficient = 2.0
fan_total_efficiency = 0.5
# Unit multiplier is theoretical tube friction, not empirical Doty calibration.
core_loss_multiplier = 1.0
# Total inlet+outlet header K, based on mean tube-passage velocity.
header_loss_coefficient = 2.0

[heat_in]
# Same inlet pressure; density scaled inversely with absolute temperature.
air_density_kg_m3 = 0.590390704672741
air_inlet_temperature_k = 598.15

[heat_out]
air_density_kg_m3 = 1.184
air_inlet_temperature_k = 298.15

[air_sizing]
reference_result = "outputs/motor_lower_lambda_screening.json"
reference_peak_internal_mass_flow_kg_s = 0.008781444097816381
expected_peak_margin = 1.25
capacity_rate_ratio_to_expected_peak = 20
working_gas_cp_j_kg_k = 1004.5
# Fixed external flow per cycle; actual peak ratio is checked after integration.
